image_description: An interior view of a rustic, traditional sawmill or lumber processing facility. The scene features heavy wooden beams and machinery in the foreground, including a large log positioned on a carriage or track system. In the background, there are stacks of processed yellow lumber planks and corrugated metal walls. The lighting is natural but somewhat dim, highlighting the texture of the wood and the industrial nature of the space.
